faq.q: How does Cekat.AI help dental clinics?
faq.a: It answers patient chats instantly 24/7 on WhatsApp, Instagram, and web chat, from treatment and price-range questions to consultation bookings, recall reminders, and aftercare education, all organized in one inbox. Your admins focus on the patient in the chair, not the phone.

faq.q: Can the AI answer price questions for scaling, braces, or veneers?
faq.a: Yes. It answers from the treatment list and prices your clinic puts into the knowledge base, quoting ranges honestly and steering patients to a consultation for the final quote. If the data is not there, the AI hands over to your admin instead of making up a number.

faq.q: Patients often disappear after asking for prices. What can be done?
faq.a: Two things. First, an instant answer keeps interest warm in the exact moment a patient asks. Second, automated follow-ups re-engage patients who have not booked, inviting a consultation or surfacing a relevant promo, so price inquiries stop dying as unanswered chats.

faq.q: How do six-month recall or braces-check reminders work?
faq.a: Reminders go out automatically through the official WhatsApp Business API based on each patient's treatment history, you set the interval, scaling every six months, braces checks monthly, and the AI handles the replies until they become bookings.

faq.q: Does the AI give diagnoses or medical advice?
faq.a: No. It only answers service information, pricing, and general education from material your clinic approves. Medical complaints, diagnoses, and treatment decisions always escalate to a dentist with the full chat history attached.

faq.q: Do we have to replace our current dental clinic software?
faq.a: No. Cekat.AI complements your existing dental clinic software through APIs and webhooks, reading schedules, writing bookings, and syncing patient data. Not using any system yet? The knowledge base alone is enough to start.

Cekat.AI complies with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP) in handling user data, with role-based access inside your team. ISO 27001 certification is in progress. Patient conversation history is only visible to authorized staff.

faq.q: How long does setup take for a dental clinic?
faq.a: Minutes, not weeks. Paste your treatment list, price ranges, doctor schedules, and aftercare SOPs into the knowledge base and the AI starts answering accurately. No coding, as easy as briefing a new admin.

faq.q: How is Cekat.AI priced, and can we try it first?
faq.a: Pricing follows subscription plans that scale with your practice and chat volume, from a single dentist to a clinic network. You can start with a free trial, or book a demo with the Cekat.AI team to see it working with your clinic's flow.
